SSC CPO Paper 2 Admit Card 2026 Release Date

The SSC CPO Paper 2 Admit Card 2026 will tentatively be available for download two to three days before the examination, according to the official SSC notice dated 18 November 2026.

For the examination scheduled on 28 November, candidates can expect the admission certificate around 25 or 26 November 2026.

The admission certificate will contain the complete examination centre address, reporting time and examination-day instructions.

SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam Pattern 2026

The SSC CPO Paper 2 examination tests candidates' English language and comprehension skills.

Details Available on SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam City Slip 2026

The city intimation facility allows candidates to check advance examination information, which may include:

  • Examination name and recruitment year
  • Paper or examination stage
  • Candidate identification details, where displayed
  • Allotted examination city
  • Scheduled examination date
  • Additional information made available in the candidate dashboard

The exact examination centre address and final reporting instructions should be checked on the separate admission certificate.

Who Can Check SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam City Slip 2026?

The city intimation facility is intended for candidates eligible to appear in Paper 2 of the SSC CPO 2025 recruitment examination.

After Paper 1, candidates were required to complete the Physical Standard Test and Physical Endurance Test stages according to the recruitment rules.

The PET/PST result was declared on 29 October 2026, followed by a corrigendum dated 16 November 2026. Candidates should follow the latest official eligibility and shortlisting information before appearing for Paper 2.

SSC CPO Selection Process 2025–26

The selection process for Sub-Inspector recruitment includes the following stages:

  1. Paper 1 Computer-Based Examination
  2. Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Endurance Test (PET)
  3. Paper 2 Computer-Based Examination
  4. Detailed Medical Examination and applicable review procedures
  5. Document Verification and final selection formalities

Candidates must satisfy the eligibility, physical and medical requirements prescribed in the recruitment notification.

SSC CPO Paper 2 Exam Day Instructions 2026

Candidates should follow these important instructions before appearing for the examination.

  • Check the examination city information through the SSC login.
  • Download the admission certificate when the download facility becomes available.
  • Verify the examination centre, date and reporting time.
  • Carry the printed admission certificate and prescribed identity documents.
  • Reach the examination centre before the reporting deadline.
  • Follow all identity verification and examination security instructions.
  • Do not carry prohibited electronic devices or restricted materials.
  • Check the SSC website regularly for further examination updates.

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), in Advertisement No. 13/2026, invites online applications for 13 vacancies in four posts: Dental Surgeon (5, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare), Ayurveda Physician (2) and Homeopathic Physician (1) (both New Delhi Municipal Council), and Scientist 'B' (5, Botanical Survey of India, Ministry of Environment Forests and Climate Change). All four posts are at Level 10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC. Candidates are shortlisted for interview, with a Recruitment Test if held. Applications are taken on upsconline.nic.in from 14 November 2026 until 1800 hrs on 04 December 2026, and eligibility is fixed on that closing date.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview

This is a recruitment by selection to four Group A Gazetted, Non-Ministerial posts under the Central Government and the New Delhi Municipal Council. The Scientist 'B' post was advertised earlier and is re-advertised with changed PwBD suitability.

Particulars Details
Recruiting Organisation Union Public Service Commission
Recruitment Name Recruitment by selection, Advertisement No. 13/2026
Advertisement No. 13/2026
Notification Date 14-11-2026
Post Names Dental Surgeon; Ayurveda Physician; Homeopathic Physician; Scientist 'B'
Total Vacancies 13
Departments Department of Health & Family Welfare; New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC); Botanical Survey of India
Qualification Varies by post: BDS, Ayurveda degree, Homoeopathy degree or Master's Degree in Botany/Horticulture/Chemistry (Organic)
Age Limit Varies by post
Pay Level or Pay Level 10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC (plus NPA for Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician)
Application Fee Rs. 25/- (no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women)
Application Mode Online at https://upsconline.nic.in
Application Dates 14-11-2026 to 04-12-2026 (1800 hrs)
Selection Process Shortlisting, Recruitment Test (if held), interview
Job Location Anywhere in India (Dental Surgeon); New Delhi (NDMC posts); Kolkata (Scientist 'B')
Official Website https://upsconline.nic.in

The official notification does not specify the Recruitment Test pattern or the interview date.

About UPSC Recruitment 2026

The Union Public Service Commission invites these applications through its online recruitment application portal. The Dental Surgeon post serves in Safdarjung Hospital, Dr. RML Hospital and RHTC Najafgarh. The Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician posts are in the AYUSH Cadre of the New Delhi Municipal Council. The Scientist 'B' post is at the Botanical Survey of India, CGO Complex, Salt Lake City, Kolkata.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement published / online applications start 14-11-2026
Last date for online applications 04-12-2026, 1800 hrs
Date for age and similar eligibility conditions, Scientist 'B' only (original closing date) 03-07-2026
Interview date To be intimated separately

Applications start on 14 November 2026. The date for determining the eligibility of all candidates in every respect is the closing date for online applications. For Scientist 'B', the notice says the original closing date, 03.07.2026, prevails for age and similar eligibility conditions.

The notice carries 13 vacancies in total: 5 + 2 + 1 + 5.

Homeopathic Physician 26111303114 New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) Level 10 plus NPA 1

Of the five Dental Surgeon vacancies, one is reserved for persons with benchmark disability (PwBD) in the Deaf and Hard of Hearing category. Ayurveda Physician, Homeopathic Physician and Scientist 'B' are not reserved for PwBD but are identified as suitable for certain disability types. The disability-type suitability tables for each post are in the official notification.

The five Scientist 'B' vacancies may be filled by candidates with these disciplines: MSc Botany - 3; MSc Horticulture - 1; MSc Chemistry (Organic) - 1.

Post Qualification Required
Dental Surgeon A recognised Bachelor of Dental Surgery degree included in part-1 of the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948), or one of the alternatives listed below; registration with any State Dental Council or Tribunal in India; completion of CRI.
Ayurveda Physician Degree in Ayurveda of a recognized University/Statutory State Board/Council/Faculty of Indian Systems of Medicine recognized under the Indian Medicine Central Council Act 1970 (48 of 1970); enrolment on the Centre or a State Register for Indian Medicine.
Homeopathic Physician Degree in Homoeopathy of a Recognised University/Statutory State Board/Council or equivalent recognised under the Homoeopathic Central Council Act, 1973 (59 of 1973); enrolment on the Central Register of Homoeopathy or State Register of Homoeopathy.
Scientist 'B' Master's Degree in Botany or Horticulture or Chemistry (Organic) from a recognised University or Institute. Desirable: Doctorate in the same subjects.

Dental Surgeon: alternative qualifications

  • A recognised Dental qualification obtained upto 01.11.1972 under Part-II of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948).
  • OR a recognised Dental qualification granted by an authority or institution outside India, only when granted to a citizen of India upto 13.08.2009 under Part-III of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948.
  • OR a citizen of India with a foreign qualification who has appeared and passed the Screening Test Examination as per Screening Test Regulation 2009 w.e.f. 13.08.2009.
  • Candidates who have not completed CRI (compulsory rotating internship) may appear for selection, but if selected must complete it satisfactorily before appointment.

Other conditions

  • Citizenship: a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from the countries named in the notice. The last three groups need a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.
  • Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of UPSC, for reasons to be recorded in writing, for candidates otherwise well qualified.
  • Where enough eligible PwBD candidates are not available for posts reserved or identified suitable for them, the experience qualification may be relaxed up to 50 per cent. The notice prints no experience requirement for these four posts.
  • Candidature at all stages is provisional, subject to satisfying the eligibility conditions.

Candidates should read the official notification for the disability-specific suitability of each post.

UPSC Age Limit 2026

The age limit differs by post. The age limit shown is the normal limit for EWS/UR candidates and the relaxed limit for SC/OBC candidates where printed. The age is further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD. The notice sets the closing date for online applications as the date for determining eligibility; for Scientist 'B' age and similar conditions, the original closing date 03.07.2026 prevails.

Post Age Limit

Ayurveda Physician 35 years for UR and 35 years for EWS
Homeopathic Physician 35 years for EWS
Scientist 'B' 35 years for UR/EWS, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC

Category Fee
Candidates other than Female/SC/ST/PwBD (OBC, EWS and Unreserved male candidates pay the full fee) Rs. 25/- (Rupees Twenty five)
SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates of any community No fee

The fee is paid by Visa/Master/Rupay Credit/Debit Card/UPI Payment or by internet banking of any Bank, and the payment mode must be opted for up to the closing date/time. Applications without the prescribed fee are summarily rejected, and no representation is entertained. Fee once paid is not refunded under any circumstance and cannot be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

UPSC Selection Process 2026

Candidates are shortlisted for interview on the basis of the information in their online applications and their performance in the Recruitment Test (RT), if held. The stages in order are:

  1. Shortlisting based on the online application, with a Recruitment Test if held.
  2. Interview.
  • If applications are large, the Commission may restrict the number called for interview by desirable qualification, higher qualification, higher experience, counting experience before or after the essential qualification, invoking experience even where none is prescribed, or by holding a Recruitment Test.
  • Minimum suitability in the interview, out of 100 marks: UR-50, OBC-45, SC/ST/PH-40.
  • Where an RT is followed by an interview, a candidate must reach the minimum suitability for the category at both stages. The RT minimum is decided by the Commission case to case.
  • The date of the interview, for which shortlisted candidates bring the print-out of the online application and other documents, will be intimated separately.
  • If a Recruitment Test forms part of selection, it will ordinarily be held at Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi and Visakhapatnam. The list is subject to change.

UPSC Job Description 2026

Dental Surgeon

  • Looks after OPD and indoor patients in Safdarjung Hospital, Dr. RML Hospital and RHTC Najafgarh.
  • Medical attendance with treatment of Central Government employees, members of their families, Central Government Pensioners and other beneficiaries covered by the Central Government Health Scheme.
  • Any other duties that may be assigned from time to time.

Ayurveda Physician

  • To diagnose and treat patients in OPD/IPD.
  • Administration of the Ayurveda Unit of which he/she is put in-charge.
  • To attend health Camps/Melas organized by NDMC/Govt. of NCT of Delhi/Govt. of India.
  • To perform any other duties assigned by the Director (AYUSH) from time to time.

Homeopathic Physician

  • To diagnose and treat patients in OPD/IPD.
  • Administration of the Homoeopathy Unit of which he/she is put in-charge.
  • To attend health Camps/Melas organized by NDMC/Govt. of NCT of Delhi/Govt. of India.
  • To perform any other duties assigned by the Director (AYUSH) from time to time.

Scientist 'B'

  • To undertake research on floristic / taxonomic revisions.
  • To identify plants.
  • To prepare proper scientific reports on field or herbarium specimens.
  • To undertake field excursions.
  • To supervise the work of Scientific Asstt. & Technical Asstt.

How to Apply Online for UPSC Recruitment 2026

  1. Go to the Commission's website https://upsconline.nic.in and read the General instructions, Profile/Module-wise instructions and instructions for uploading documents on the menu bar of the home page.
  2. Register on the portal to get a Universal Registration Number (URN), giving the details of one Photo ID Card (Aadhaar is strongly advised) in the URN profile.
  3. Fill the Common Application Form (CAF), uploading a photograph and capturing a live photograph, and uploading three signatures made one below the other in black ink on plain white paper.
  4. Fill the post/vacancy-specific module for the advertised post and upload, in pdf, the documents supporting each claim (date of birth, category, disability, qualification, experience, age relaxation).
  5. Pay the fee of Rs. 25/- by card, UPI or net banking if not exempted.
  6. Submit the application by 1800 hrs on 04-12-2026 and take a print-out of the finally submitted application. An Application Number is generated; keep it with the URN for communication.
  • Failure to provide the required information/documents along with the CAF cancels candidature for the post.
  • Candidates are not required to send printouts or documents by post or by hand. They bring them if called for interview.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the closing date.

Documents Required

  • Matriculation/10th certificate or mark sheet showing date of birth.
  • Degree/Diploma certificate; if unavailable, a provisional certificate with mark sheets for all academic years.
  • Order/letter on equivalent qualification, if one is claimed as equivalent.
  • Experience certificate in the prescribed proforma from the Head of Organisation, where claimed. Pay slips, resumes, appointment letters, relieving letters and unsigned experience certificates must not be uploaded in the Document Upload Module.
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma for SC/ST/OBC; OBC candidates also a declaration of non-creamy layer status.
  • Certificate of Disability in the prescribed proforma for PwBD candidates.
  • Age relaxation certificates for Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers, or Central/UT Government employees (issued after the date of advertisement).
  • Name-change documents, if the name has changed after matriculation.
  • Certificates for professional registration, language, publications, NET, GATE, conference and internship claims, where made.

Documents in a language other than Hindi or English need a transcript attested by a Gazetted officer or notary.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Scientist 'B' was advertised on 13.06.2026 as Advertisement No. 06/2026 (Vacancy No. 26060683213, closing date 03.07.2026) and is re-advertised under Advertisement No. 13/2026 with changed PwBD suitability.
  • Scientist 'B' vacancies are now identified as suitable for PwBD candidates in the Hard of Hearing (HH), Specific Learning Disability (SLD), Mental Illness (MI) and Multiple Disability (MD) categories. These were not identified earlier.
  • Candidates who already applied against Advertisement No. 06/2026 need not apply again. They may edit their existing applications. If they retain them unchanged, the data is preserved and merged with the new advertisement.
  • Applications cannot be withdrawn, and no correction is allowed in the application form after submission.
  • The URN profile has a one-time edit facility. Changes do not affect applications already submitted.
  • All correspondence is by e-mail only, so candidates must give a correct and active e-mail address. The interview schedule is e-mailed and posted on the Commission's website.
  • Candidates shortlisted for interview must send self-attested copies of documents as and when demanded. At the interview they must bring the print-out and the original documents. Failure to present them disqualifies the candidate and bars reimbursement of travelling expenses.
  • False information may lead to rejection and debarment from UPSC examinations or Central Government employment, permanently or for a specified period.
  • Dental Surgeon: all vacancies are permanent but are filled on temporary basis. Appointees are confirmed after probation of one year.
  • Scientist 'B' probation is two years, and a mandatory induction training of at least two weeks is needed for successful completion.
  • Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician: probation is one year.
  • Persons in regular Government service must declare that they have informed their Head of Office in writing about applying.

SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE 2026: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the notification for the Grade 'C' Stenographers Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE) 2026 to fill 320 tentative vacancies across six participating services and cadres. The online application process started on 17 November 2026, and eligible departmental candidates can apply through the official website at ssc.gov.in until 8 December 2026 at 11:00 PM. The Computer Based Examination is tentatively scheduled for February–March 2027 in Delhi-NCR.

This examination is intended for eligible serving Stenographer Grade 'D' personnel of the participating government services and cadres. It is not an open recruitment examination for fresh candidates. Applicants must meet the prescribed service eligibility conditions and submit their applications through the proper departmental channel. Check the vacancy details, eligibility, examination pattern, selection process and application instructions below.

SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE Eligibility Criteria 2026

The SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE 2026 is restricted to eligible departmental candidates serving in the participating services and cadres. The required length of approved service and other conditions vary by cadre.

Service / Cadre Eligibility Requirements
Central Secretariat Stenographers Service Generally, six years of approved service as Stenographer Grade D, subject to the conditions and exceptions in the notification.
Railway Board Secretariat Stenographers Service Generally, six years of approved service as Stenographer Grade D, with specified exceptions for existing employees.
Indian Foreign Service Branch (B) Six years of approved service and completion of prescribed training, subject to the five-year provision for specified existing employees.
Armed Forces Headquarters Stenographers Service Three years of approved and continuous service in Grade D, subject to the applicable provisions.
Election Commission of India Stenographers Service Three years of approved and continuous service in Grade D, subject to the conditions in the notification.
Central Vigilance Commission Five years of regular service in Stenographer Grade D in the Commission.

The crucial date for calculating approved service is 1 July 2026 for the Central Secretariat, Railway Board, Indian Foreign Service Branch (B) and Election Commission of India cadres. For Armed Forces Headquarters and Central Vigilance Commission, it is 1 January 2026.

Important: Candidates should read the detailed cadre-wise service conditions in the official notification. Meeting a general service-duration requirement alone may not establish eligibility, as additional rules and exceptions apply.

  1. Computer Based Examination (Part A)

  3. Evaluation of Service Records / APARs (Part C)
  4. Preparation of the final merit list and recommendation for inclusion in the applicable cadre select list

Candidates must secure the required qualifying standards at the relevant stages. Final selection will be based on aggregate performance and the applicable cadre-wise vacancy and reservation provisions.

How to Apply for SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE 2026?

Eligible departmental candidates can submit their applications online through the official Staff Selection Commission website.

  1. Visit ssc.gov.in.

  3. Log in and select Grade 'C' Stenographers Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2026.
  4. Fill in the application form with the required personal and service details.
  5. Complete the live photograph capture process according to the portal instructions.
  6. Upload the scanned signature and required supporting documents.
  7. Review the completed application carefully.
  8. Submit the online application by 8 December 2026 at 11:00 PM.
  9. Take a printout of the submitted application form.
  10. Arrange for the printed form and supporting documents to be forwarded through the prescribed departmental channel.

Candidates should ensure that their Head of Department or Head of Office forwards the completed application to SSC Northern Region within the applicable deadline. Online submission alone does not complete the prescribed departmental forwarding requirement.

The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), New Delhi, has one regular Scientist-D (Non-Medical) vacancy in Level 12 of the Pay Matrix (Rs.78,800-2,09,200), with initial posting at ICMR-National Institute for Research in Bacterial Infections (NIRBI), Kolkata. Essential qualification is a Masters in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences or a Pharm-D degree, with 8 years of experience. Indian citizens can apply online at recruitment.icmr.org.in up to 31 December 2026, 5:30 PM (Advt. No. ICMR/Rectt/Sc-D/02/2026-RPCell).

About ICMR

The Indian Council of Medical Research is an autonomous organisation under the Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India. According to the notice, it deals with biomedical and health research in various areas, in collaboration with national and international agencies. It works through its headquarters at New Delhi, 29 Institutes/Centres and a large number of field stations across the country.

Who Can Apply

Only Indian citizens may apply. Eligibility must be met on the last date of submission of the application.

PostEssential QualificationEssential Experience
Scientist-D (Non-Medical)Masters from a recognised university in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences OR Pharm-D degree recognized by UGC/PCI8 Years

Desirable Qualification and Experience

  • DQ: Ph.D. from a recognised University in Biophysics/Molecular Biology/Biochemistry.
  • DE: Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences, relevant to the job requirements, in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions. The notice gives research on structural biology using Cryo-Electron microscope [Cryo-EM] for biological specimens, in particular macromolecular complexes, with the use of Cryo-EM reconstruction algorithms and computational skills, as the job requirement.

How Experience Is Counted

  • PhD is considered as 4 years' experience, irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree.
  • MD/MS or equivalent is considered as 3 years' experience.
  • MVSc is considered as 2 years' experience.
  • MPH/M.Tech/ME is not considered as any experience.
  • Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences, relevant to the job requirements, in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions is admissible.
  • The period spent on obtaining the minimum essential educational qualification does not count towards experience.
  • Qualifications and experience may be relaxed for exceptionally meritorious candidates, with the approval of the DG, ICMR, for reasons to be recorded in writing.

Age Limit

The upper age limit is 45 years, relaxable in accordance with GOI instructions. The notice does not list the relaxations category by category.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

Pay and Tenure

The post is in Level 12 of the Pay Matrix (Rs.78,800-2,09,200), 7th CPC Scale, with usual allowances as admissible to ICMR employees. The appointment is on regular basis under Direct Recruitment. The initial posting is at ICMR-NIRBI, Kolkata, with all India transfer liability under the Council.

How to Apply for ICMR Scientist-D (Non-Medical)

  1. Visit https://recruitment.icmr.org.in and register. The details filled in the registration form cannot be changed once registered.
  2. Acknowledgement of successful registration is sent to the registered email ID/mobile number.
  3. Click "Applicant login" and use the User ID and password received on email and mobile number.
  4. Click "Go to Application Form" and fill the sections one by one, using "Save and Next". The next section opens only when mandatory details are filled and required documents are uploaded.
  5. Upload the documents, photograph and signature as per the instructions.
  6. Click "Submit". You are then redirected to make the payment, and the application is considered complete once payment is done. Fee is accepted only through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card.
  7. After successful submission, the final printout of the application can be taken again.

No offline application form or copy of the downloaded form is accepted. A hard copy of the final printout with all uploaded documents may be submitted when ICMR calls upon the candidate to do so.

Application Fee

CategoryFee
Candidates not exemptedRs.1500/- (non-refundable)
SC/ST/Women/PWD/EWSExempted

The fee is paid through the online link given in the application form.

Documents Named in the Notice

  • Scanned self-attested/attested copies of certificates in support of educational qualifications (from Matric onwards).
  • Certificates of detailed marks obtained in these courses.
  • Date of birth proof.
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD).
  • Experience certificates.
  • Photograph, which should be unattested, without cap or goggles (spectacles are allowed), and signature.

Candidates who fail to upload self-attested copies of the required documents have their candidature cancelled and are not allowed to take part in later stages. The notice also advises keeping a few identical photographs in reserve for use at the time of test or document verification.

Selection and Interview

Selection is made on the basis of a computer-based test (MCQs) or interview or both. The computer-based test, if conducted, is based on the understanding of research methods and is of qualifying nature. The notice does not give a test or interview date, venue or marks.

  • First, all candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility in age, educational qualifications and experience (wherever required) are shortlisted.
  • If too many are shortlisted to call all for interview, ICMR further shortlists on criteria fixed by the Competent Authority, ICMR.
  • ICMR generally prefers to call candidates with higher experience in the relevant fields or higher educational qualification, as decided by the Appointing Authority. This may vary from case to case.
  • At the time of personal discussion, applicants working in Centre/State Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings and Govt. funded research agencies must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer, with an undertaking that the applicant will be relieved within one month of receipt of the appointment order.

Important Instructions

  • Applications received after the closing date, for whatever reason, are liable to be rejected, as are incomplete applications or those without supporting documents.
  • Duplicate applications result in cancellation of all such applications, without intimation.
  • No request to change particulars in the online form is entertained after submission.
  • Likely causes of rejection include: more than one application for a category, incomplete or non-online application, fee not fully deposited, lacking the academic qualification on the cut-off date, age outside the limit on the cut-off/closing date, and missing documents (including the MCI registration certificate and category certificate).
  • Documents are checked only at scrutiny. False or suppressed information can lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, even after appointment, and criminal prosecution.
  • Outside influence, political or otherwise, disqualifies the candidate.
  • Further details are displayed on the ICMR website only. ICMR may modify, cancel or publish afresh the vacancy circular, and disputes fall under the jurisdiction of Courts in New Delhi.
  • For technical or payment queries, call on working days between 9:30 AM and 5:30 PM (IST) on O11-26589167 (as printed in the notice) or email [email protected].

RITES Limited (a Government of India Enterprise, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways) is hiring 6 Senior Technical Assistant (Draftsman/Buildings) on a regular basis for Civil/Architecture (RG/48/26, 4 posts) and Electrical (RG/49/26, 2 posts), at pay Rs. 26,000-96,000. Diploma holders aged up to 32 years with 2 years' experience can apply online at www.rites.com from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026.

About RITES

RITES Limited is a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India. The notice describes it as a leading multidisciplinary consultancy organisation in transport, infrastructure and related technologies. Its office is at Shikhar, Plot No.-1, Sector-29, Gurugram, 122001. The notice says that in any dispute the English original text will be valid.

Vacancy Details

The notice lists 6 vacancies in total across two vacancy codes. The break-up below is copied from the notice; dashes mean no post.

Vacancy CodePostUREWSOBC (NCL)SCSTTotalPwBDAge Limit
RG/48/26Senior Technical Assistant (Draftsman/Buildings) - Civil or Architecture3---14132 years

One post under RG/48/26 is horizontally reserved for persons with benchmark disabilities; the notice's category-wise break-up shows 1 post in the third identified category column. The notice says the number of vacancies may change.

Who Can Apply

Only Indian citizens aged 18 years or above can apply. Age, experience and all other eligibility are counted as on the cut-off date, 15 December 2026.

PostEssential QualificationExperience
RG/48/26 - Senior Technical Assistant (Draftsman/Buildings), Civil or ArchitectureFull-time diploma in Civil / Architecture EngineeringMinimum 2 years post-qualification experience; relevant experience: minimum 2 years' work on preparing building drawings on AutoCAD or equivalent drafting software
RG/49/26 - Senior Technical Assistant (Draftsman/Buildings), ElectricalFull-time diploma in Electrical EngineeringMinimum 2 years post-qualification experience; relevant experience: minimum 2 years' work on preparing building drawings on AutoCAD or equivalent drafting software
  • Candidates with a higher qualification but without the stated essential qualification are not eligible.
  • Minimum 50% marks in the essential qualification are needed by UR/EWS candidates, and by SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts. Reserved-category candidates (SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD, as applicable) need at least 45% against reserved posts.
  • Where the certificate or marksheet shows no percentage, a conversion formula from the university/institute is needed; if none exists, an undertaking signed by an authorised representative is required, and 5 on a 10-point scale is treated as 50%.
  • Training (other than on-the-job), internship, teaching, fellowship and PhD research are not counted as experience. Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in the relevant field counts as post-qualification experience, if all other criteria are met.
  • The qualification must be from a university or institution recognised as set out in the notice (BTE/AICTE recognised, as applicable); equivalent qualifications need an equivalence certificate.

Age Limit and Relaxation

The age limit is 32 years for both posts, counted as on 15 December 2026. Relaxation is given on production of the required certificate.

Ex-servicemen are also mentioned among the categories for reservation, relaxation and concession as per Government orders, where applicable. Persons with disabilities from the identified categories (locomotor disability and hearing impairment for both posts) may apply even if no vacancy is specially reserved for them, and are considered on the general eligibility standard.

Pay and Tenure

The pay for both vacancy codes is Rs. 26,000-96,000. The notice adds that candidates moving from the 8th CPC CDA scale to the 4th PRC IDA scale on appointment get only one increment benefit, and final pay fixing follows implementation of the 4th PRC report, if any.

  • Other benefits named: leave as per leave rules, maternity/paternity leave as per company rules for regular employees, medical facility, group insurance and leave encashment.
  • Appointment is on one year probation from the date of joining. The employee remains on probation until the confirmation order is issued.
  • For confirmation the candidate must pass a screening test towards the end of probation. If not passed, probation may be extended and further action follows company policy.
  • Selected candidates may be posted anywhere in India or abroad as per company requirement.
  • Candidates from government departments/PSUs are eligible for protection of basic pay as per company policy until they complete the service of the minimum of the pay scale.

How to Apply for RITES Recruitment 2026

  1. Make sure you meet the conditions for the post, as the notice says RITES does not examine eligibility in detail while receiving online applications.
  2. Apply online through the registration programme in the Career section of www.rites.com.
  3. Note the Registration Number the system generates at the top of the online form; it is needed for later contact with RITES.
  4. Fill in the identity proof details carefully, as the original is needed in later stages of selection.
  5. After filling in the details under the application form option, submit the application.
  6. Upload all documents that support your claims, with clear and legible scanned copies, before submitting.
  7. Pay the fee in the Payment section and, after successful payment, download the final application form.
  8. Keep a signed print of the application with the Registration Number. Do not send hard copies of documents by post or courier.

The notice states that the application is considered incomplete and rejected if fee payment is not successful. Candidates should make sure an invoice is generated on payment; if it cannot be downloaded, they should immediately email [email protected] with registration details. One application per vacancy code is to be submitted, and a submitted application cannot be changed. A valid email ID is needed. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application with the prescribed fee for each, at their own risk, since the selection schedule for two posts may fall at the same time.

Documents named in the notice

Documents to upload with the online form:

  • High school certificate as proof of date of birth
  • Academic and professional qualification certificates with marksheets of all semesters/years
  • Percentage conversion document issued by the university/institute, where applicable
  • EWS/SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD certificate in the Government of India format, where applicable
  • Proof of identity and address (passport, voter ID, driving licence, Aadhaar etc.) and PAN card
  • Experience proof in a single PDF in chronological order (offer letter, appointment order, relieving order, service certificate, pay slips)
  • Any other certificate supporting the candidature

At document verification, candidates bring one recent passport-size colour photo, the signed print of the online application, the duly filled Annexure-A checklist with self-attested copies in order, and originals. The Annexure-A checklist also lists 2 recent passport-size colour photos. For current employment, proof such as a joining letter with last month's pay slip or Form-16 is needed. For CTC/salary proof, the last Form-16, appraisal letter or pay slip is shown again on the day of the interview.

Selection and Interview

The notice describes a written test, then certificate scrutiny and document verification. Appointment offers are made in order of merit to the extent of the notified vacancies, and appointment is subject to medical fitness as per RITES rules.

Written test

  • 125 objective-type questions, one mark each, in 2.5 hours. No negative marking applies.
  • PwBD candidates get 50 extra minutes.
  • To be considered further, UR/EWS candidates need at least 50% marks, and SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD candidates against reserved posts at least 45%.
  • Candidates can choose Hindi or English for the selection process.
  • Candidates choose two preferred test centres in the online form: Delhi/Gurugram, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Guwahati and Bhubaneswar. All centres except Delhi/Gurugram are tentative. RITES may allot a centre not in the candidate's preference. The exact address, date and time will be intimated separately.

Syllabus topics

  • RG/48/26 (Civil or Architecture): drawing practice and CAD, architectural design, building types and site planning, building materials, building construction, building planning and services, RCC and steel structures, estimation and quantity surveying, surveying, fire safety, green buildings and energy codes, and contemporary construction technology.
  • RG/49/26 (Electrical): drawing practice and CAD, basic electrical engineering, AC fundamentals, electrical materials and basic electronics, electrical machines, measurement and instruments, electrical power systems, switchgear, protection and earthing, and wiring, estimation and utilisation.

Certificate scrutiny and document verification

  • Verification is only for candidates qualifying in the written test, in the ratio of 1:3 of the vacancies notified at the start.
  • If shortfalls are found in the certificates, the notice says the candidates called for the interview after document verification will be listed on the website. Candidates called must bring all certificates in original, including those that cover the shortfall.
  • Candidates failing to produce shortfall documents at verification before the interview have their candidature cancelled.
  • If two or more candidates score equal marks, the older candidate is placed above the younger one in the merit list.
  • Next candidates on the qualified list are scrutinised only if the notified vacancies are not filled by the first verification.

Fee paid by SC/ST/PwBD candidates is refunded when they take part in the further selection process, after their category certificate is submitted and checked, less GST/bank charges, to the original account/card used. They must submit the certificate on the portal while paying. Fee paid by any method other than the prescribed one is not accepted and the application is rejected. For fee problems the helpdesk number is 011-33557000, extension code 13221, and the helpdesk email is [email protected].

  • Government department/PSU employees working on a regular basis must apply through proper channel. Those applying directly must bring a No Objection Certificate at the interview (if called). An NOC submitted after the fixed date is not accepted.
  • Selected serving government/PSU employees are allowed to join only after being duly relieved by their parent organisation.
  • OBC (NCL) and SC/ST candidates need a caste certificate in the prescribed annexure format valid up to the closing date. An OBC (NCL) certificate should be not more than one year old from the last date, and OBC (NCL) candidates give a declaration in Annexure-III format at verification.
  • EWS candidates need an income and asset certificate in Government of India format valid for FY 2026-27, as on the last date. Those who cannot produce a valid certificate are treated as unreserved.
  • An offer letter is not accepted as experience proof; a joining and relieving order or experience certificate is needed.
  • Where the qualification requires a specialisation, a certificate from the university/institute clearly naming it is needed.
  • No train/bus fare, TA or DA is payable, and legal jurisdiction in any dispute is Delhi.

  • The management may cancel, restrict, extend, modify or change the recruitment at any stage, without notice or reasons.

REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL) has invited applications for 01 expert as Senior Consultant (Renewable Energy) on a contractual basis for a period of 01 year, further extendable based on performance and requirement. About RECPDCL Senior Consultant (Renewable Energy)

REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL) {formerly known as REC Power Distribution Company Limited} is a wholly owned subsidiary of REC Ltd., a “Maharatna CPSE” under Ministry of Power, Government of India. RECPDCL is rendering expert consultancy services across the value chain of Indian power sector. The spectrum of consultancy services includes inter-alia, Project Management Consultancy (PMC) works, IT implementation in Power Sector, Smart Metering, Smart Grid, Solar Projects, Third Party Quality Inspection, Monitoring of Rural Electrification works, Feeder Renovation Program, Energy Audit, HVDS study, Load flow study of power system networks, preparation of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), Implementation of Power Transmission projects and such others. Also, RECPDCL is closely associated with various Govt. of India Schemes viz., R-APDRP, IPDS, PMDP, RFMS, NFMS etc. and is working in close association with the Central/ State power utilities across the Country.

Experience

Post-qualification experience in the renewable energy sector, with proven experience in planning, development, implementation, operation, or consultancy of renewable energy projects including Solar, Wind, Hybrid RE, BESS, Pumped Storage, Green Hydrogen, or other clean energy projects.

Desirable Relevant experience shall include but not limited to:

  • Experience in preparation of feasibility studies, DPRs, techno-commercial evaluation, financial analysis, bid process management (RFQ/RFP), contract management, and project execution under EPC, IPP, PPP, or Developer models.
  • Experience in regulatory compliance, power evacuation and grid integration, stakeholder coordination, and liaison with Government agencies, Utilities, DISCOMs, Developers, Financial Institutions, and Regulatory Authorities.
  • Experience in identification and assessment of renewable energy business opportunities, project due diligence, risk assessment, project monitoring, and advisory support for renewable energy and energy transition initiatives.

Punjab & Sind Bank (a Govt. of India Undertaking), through its Head Office HRD Department in New Delhi, is engaging one Chief Risk Officer (CRO) on contract for professional services. The initial tenure is three years, the age limit is 40 years minimum and less than 55 years (as on 01.11.2026), and the pay is to be negotiated. Applications are online only at punjabandsind.bank.in from 7 November 2026 to 22 November 2026; the time of closing is not printed.

PSB CHIEF RISK OFFICER at a Glance

ParticularsDetails
OrganisationPunjab & Sind Bank (A Govt. of India Undertaking)
PostChief Risk Officer (CRO), engagement on contract basis for professional services
Vacancies01 (provisional, may vary)
Contract TermThree years initially, extendable by one year at a time, maximum five years
Experience RequiredAt least five years in Corporate Credit and Risk Management at AGM level or above in Public Sector Banks, or an equivalent senior position
Job LocationPreferably Head Office/Corporate Office; the Bank may post to any office in India
How to ApplyOnline through https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ only
Last Date22.11.2026 (application starts 07.11.2026)
SelectionScrutiny, shortlisting and interview before the Selection Committee

The official notification does not specify the pay amount or an advertisement number. It says compensation will be negotiated.

About PSB

Punjab & Sind Bank describes itself as a Govt. of India Undertaking, with its Head Office HRD Department at NBCC Building Block 3, Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi - 110023. The Chief Risk Officer will oversee risk management across the Bank, including at group level covering Domestic Operations, Domestic Subsidiaries and Branches.

Who Can Apply

Nationality

A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam intending to settle permanently. The last four groups need a certificate of eligibility issued by the Govt. of India.

Essential qualification and experience (as on 22.11.2026)

  • Graduate Degree from a university/institution recognised by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies.
  • At least five years' experience in Corporate Credit and Risk Management at the level of Assistant General Manager or above in one or more Public Sector Banks; or in an equivalent senior position, with similar roles and responsibilities, in one or more regulated lending entities, as may be determined by the Bank and the CRO Selection Committee, with minimum experience of one year in Corporate Credit and one year in Risk Management.
  • Along with any one of: (a) professional certification in financial risk management from the Global Association of Risk Professionals; (b) Professional Risk Management Certification from the PRMIA Institute; or at least two years' experience as Chief Risk Officer in a regulated lending entity where the CRO must be appointed with Board approval under a regulatory requirement.

Desirable

Preference may be given to candidates with one or more of the following:

  • Chartered Financial Analyst charter from the CFA Institute.
  • Chartered Accountant qualification from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or an equivalent qualification obtained abroad.
  • Cost and Management Accountant qualification from the Institute of Cost Accountants of India or an equivalent qualification obtained abroad.
  • Postgraduate degree in Finance, Economics, Banking, Risk Management, Business Administration or a related field.
  • Certification or specialised qualification in treasury risk, credit risk, operational risk, cyber risk, climate risk, data analytics or model-risk management.
  • Desirable experience: good understanding of market risk and/or liquidity management and/or operational risk, with exposure to analytics an added advantage.

Age limit

Minimum 40 years of age and less than 55 years of age (as on 01.11.2026). The notice prints no age relaxation. Date of birth as per the Secondary School Certificate (SSC)/School leaving certificate must confirm age eligibility.

Pay and Terms

  • Pay: the compensation and terms and conditions will be negotiated/finalised depending upon the suitability of the candidate.
  • Tenure: the CRO may initially be engaged for a fixed contractual tenure of three years, extendable by one year at a time, up to a maximum of five years, subject to annual performance review by the Board/Risk Management Committee of the Board.
  • The engagement is purely contractual and gives no right to claim regular employment or absorption in the Bank.
  • Working hours and weekly off/holidays are as applicable to the Bank's serving employees.
  • Leave: 30 days' paid leave per calendar year, not more than 05 days at a time. Absence beyond 30 days in a contract year leads to a proportionate deduction from the consolidated payment, and unavailed leave lapses at the end of the contract year.
  • PF, Gratuity, Pension etc. do not apply, and no other allowance, payment, benefit or facility is payable beyond what the notice mentions.
  • Location: preferably Head Office/Corporate Office; the Bank reserves the right to post the candidate to any office in India depending on administrative requirements.

PSB CHIEF RISK OFFICER Job Description

The CRO oversees the entire risk management process of the Bank, including at group level, reviews risk models, and develops policies, procedures and pricing models. The role is grouped under credit risk, market risk, operational risk, and liquidity and interest rate risk management, and also includes RBI guidelines applicable from time to time. Annexure I of the notice lists these duties:

  • Act as risk assessor and overall in charge of the Bank's Risk Management function, and advise top management.
  • Implement and maintain an enterprise-wide integrated risk management and governance framework covering credit, investment, operational, market and compliance risk.
  • Report the Bank's risk profile periodically to Risk Committees, top management and the Board, and implement BASEL guidelines as per RBI directives.
  • Oversee the Fraud Risk Management Department (FRMD) and strengthen frameworks including EIRMS, policy and cyber risk governance.
  • Credit risk: bank-wide credit risk management, risk limits and risk appetite, stress testing, preparation of the Annual ICAAP document, monitoring of large exposures, and validation of Credit Risk Assessment (CRA)/scoring models.
  • Market risk: turn the Board's framework into policies and procedures, and guide the market risk team on interest rate risk, equity price risk, derivatives, country limits, counterparty bank limits and stress testing.
  • Operational risk: supervise the ORM Cell, review operational risk policies, conduct the Product and Process Approval Committee, Credit Policy Committee, ALCO and ORMC meetings, oversee AML/CFT controls and IT security risk, and ensure Board RMC meetings are held as scheduled.
  • Liquidity and interest rate risk: oversee the liquidity position of all PSB Zones and departments, supervise the ALM Cell and review the Asset Liability Management Policy.

The notice adds that any other roles and responsibilities may be assigned by the authorities/Bank.

How to Apply for PSB CHIEF RISK OFFICER

  1. Log on to the Bank's website https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ and, on the Home Page under the link "Recruitment", click the relevant Notification. No other mode of application is accepted.
  2. Before registering, keep a valid personal email ID and mobile number active until the appointment process ends. Call letters are sent to the registered email ID.
  3. Spell your name and your father's/husband's name exactly as in your certificates, mark sheets and identity proof. Any change found may disqualify the candidature.
  4. Pay the application fee online only. Cash, Demand Drafts, Cheques, Money Orders and Postal Stamps are not accepted.
  5. Submit the application by 22.11.2026. Applications received after the stipulated date and incomplete applications are rejected.

Application fee

The fee is Rs. 1000/- + GST as applicable. The table prints Rs. 1180/- (including CGST and SGST) for New Delhi and Rs. 1180/- (including IGST) for out of New Delhi. Transaction charges are borne by the candidate. The fee is non-refundable and cannot be held in reserve for any other selection. An application cannot be withdrawn once made.

Documents named in the notice

  • Scanned photograph and signature as per the guidelines in the advertisement; image formats .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .bmp, .gif.
  • Scanned thumb impression and handwritten declaration: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Education, experience, reservation certificates and date of birth proof, scanned in PDF format only.
  • Original documents at the interview; candidates will not be allowed to participate without them. Copies of the same passport-size photograph are to be brought for the interview.

Selection Process

The selection process may broadly comprise preliminary scrutiny of applications, shortlisting, a personal interaction/interview before the Selection Committee, and verification of credentials. Final selection is on marks obtained in the interview, by merit ranking.

  • Scrutiny: applications are checked against age, qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions.
  • Shortlisting: based on relevant experience, seniority, professional credentials and suitability, and on academic track record. Only shortlisted candidates are called. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience gives no right to be called.
  • Interview: assesses knowledge of credit, market, operational, liquidity, technology, cyber, climate and other material risks, plus leadership ability, independence of judgement, regulatory awareness and ability to interact with the Board and senior management.
  • Verification of credentials, vigilance status, integrity, reputation and antecedents.

The interview venue, date and time will be informed in the call letter, sent by email only. Candidates attend at their own cost. The notice mentions no written test.

Important Instructions

  • Candidates serving in Government/Public Sector Undertakings including Banks must produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview, failing which the candidature will not be considered.
  • The selected candidate must produce a valid discharge/relieving letter from the present employer before joining.
  • Appointment is subject to medical fitness, the required qualifications and experience, and clearances, verifications and background checks.
  • The number of vacancies is provisional and may vary with the Bank's requirement.
  • If several applications are made, only the last valid complete application is retained.
  • Requests to change the interview date, time or venue will not be entertained.
  • The Bank may change, add or cancel the selection process, or cancel the whole process, and will announce this on its website or by email.
  • False information or suppressed facts lead to cancellation, forfeiture of fee and possible termination after appointment. Canvassing in any form is a disqualification.
  • Any dispute is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts at Delhi, and the English version prevails.

What Is the IBPS PO Reserve List?

The IBPS PO reserve list is maintained to consider eligible candidates for provisional allotment against vacancies remaining or subsequently by participating banks, in accordance with the applicable recruitment rules.

Agentic AI

  • OR AI Security & Governance: risk assessments, security reviews, threat modelling, adversarial testing and AI governance checks; guardrails, access controls and audit trails; compliance with RBI frameworks and Bank policies.
  • OR DevSecOps: integrate SAST, DAST, dependency and container security, infrastructure-as-code validation and automated compliance.
  • OR AI Quality Assurance – Testing: functional, integration, performance, security and AI-specific tests including bias, groundedness and explainability; maintain dashboards, defect logs and production-readiness evidence.

Deputy Manager (Data Scientist)

  • Front end: design, develop, test and maintain responsive, accessible web interfaces for enterprise and AI-driven applications; convert UX/UI designs into reusable components; build interfaces for conversational AI, knowledge assistants, dashboards and agentic workflows; optimise rendering, load time and caching.
  • OR Integration (EIS/MuleSoft): develop end-to-end application components and integrate AI services, enterprise systems, APIs and data platforms; design integration between AI services and core banking systems.

  3. Upload the photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression and hand-written declaration, and capture a live photograph through webcam or mobile phone.

  5. Choose one examination centre, if applicable.
  6. Pay the fee online through the payment gateway (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/UPI etc.); no change is allowed after payment.

This recruitment is conducted by the Central Recruitment & Promotion Department of State Bank of India at its Corporate Centre in Mumbai. Enquiries go through the "CONTACT US/ Post Your Query" link on the Bank's careers page; the notice also prints the phone number 022 22820427 and the email [email protected] on its letterhead.

Educational Qualification

Any one of the following, from a University/ Institution/ Board recognized by Govt. of India/ approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies (as on 31.10.2026):

  • B. Tech/ B.E. in Computer Science/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Software Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electronics/ Electronics & Communications Engineering/Cyber Security or Equivalent Degree in these disciplines with minimum 50% score; or

  • M. Tech/ M. Sc in Computer Science/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Information Technology/ Software Engineering/ Electronics/ Electronics & Communications Engineering/Cyber Security or Equivalent Degree in these disciplines.

As on 31.10.2026, the applicant must have at least 15-20 years post qualification experience in Information Technology/ Information Security in Banks/ Large Corporates/ PSUs/ FIs/ Financial Services Organizations/ Financial & Technology Consulting firms, of which minimum 5 years should be in the core domain area of Information Security/Cyber Security/ Cyber Defence in Banks / FIs at Senior Management Level.   • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
  • Certified Chief Information Security Officer (CCISO)
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in Information Security, Cyber Defence, Security Operations, Enterprise Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, Security Architecture, Cloud Security, and IT Infrastructure.
  • Experienced in engaging with Board-level stakeholders, regulators, auditors, and executive leadership to strengthen cyber resilience and support secure business growth.
  • Experienced in managing large-scale security transformation programs, leading multidisciplinary teams, overseeing managed security services, implementing AI-driven security operations, and protecting critical financial infrastructure.

  • Annual CTC is negotiable and depends on experience, current emoluments in the present employment and place of posting. CTC will be offered based on industry standards, the candidate's experience and last drawn salary.
  • CTC is split into Fixed Pay and Variable Pay in the ratio 80:20. Besides CTC, no other perks shall be paid.

If the contract ends before 6 months (from 2nd year onwards), variable pay is released on a pro-rata basis, subject to income tax deduction.

SBI Recruitment 2026 Job Description

Activities / Functions

  • Provide consolidated visibility of observations arising from regulatory reviews, audits, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, red teaming and security incidents.
  • Prioritise risks based on business criticality, exploitability, external exposure, threat intelligence, regulatory implications and potential customer or operational impact.
  • Monitor remediation of critical and high-risk observations and facilitate resolution of cross-functional dependencies and bottlenecks.
  • Promote root-cause analysis and enterprise-wide corrective measures for systemic and recurring deficiencies.
  • Strengthen evidence-based closure through validation, retesting and residual-risk assessment.
  • Oversee improvements in vulnerability, patch, configuration, change, asset, application/API lifecycle and security advisory management.
  • Review the effectiveness and integration of DevSecOps, WAF, ITSAM, vulnerability management, DLP and SIEM platforms.
  • Provide oversight of emerging risks, including AI governance, SBOM/AIBOM maturity, ransomware readiness, backup assurance and digital/payment transaction risks.
  • Establish governance dashboards covering risk trends, ageing, remediation progress, recurring observations and residual risks.
  • Coordinate significant technology and cybersecurity matters with regulators, auditors, consultants and subject-matter experts.

KRAs

  • Provide strategic oversight of enterprise technology and cybersecurity risks, ensuring visibility, prioritisation and timely escalation.
  • Drive risk-based, systemic remediation of material audit, regulatory, vulnerability and security observations.
  • Oversee effectiveness of critical technology and cybersecurity controls and strengthen assurance mechanisms.
  • Strengthen cyber resilience, ransomware preparedness, recoverability and emerging technology risk governance.
  • Oversee regulatory commitments, security advisories, policy improvements and governance-based exception management.
  • Drive cross-functional accountability for resolution of systemic technology and cybersecurity risks.
  • Lead strategic governance reviews and provide senior management with consolidated risk posture for timely intervention.

Key interactions include application owners and GITC departments, ISD, Information Security, infrastructure, business and operational-risk functions, regulators, auditors, external consultants and technology partners. Measures of success include reduced ageing and recurrence of critical observations and timely systemic remediation. The notice says KRAs shall be assigned on joining, the job profile is illustrative, and additional roles may be assigned by the Bank.

The Export-Import Bank of India (India Exim Bank) has announced a recruitment drive for Management Trainee and Manager posts in 2026. The bank invites applications from eligible candidates for a total of 120 positions, including 90 Management Trainee and 30 Manager vacancies.

The short recruitment notice was published on 11 November 2026, and the last date for submitting applications is 11 December 2026. Interested candidates can visit the official Exim Bank careers website for the detailed advertisement, eligibility conditions and online application information.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 Overview

Company Name Export-Import Bank of India (India Exim Bank)
Post Name Management Trainee (MT) and Manager
Advertisement No HRM/ MT/M/2026-27/05
No of Posts 120 Posts
Job Type Public Sector Bank Jobs
Qualification Graduation / MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS / CA / Relevant Professional Qualification (subject to official post-wise eligibility)
Age Limit As per detailed Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 Notification: MT 21 to 28 Years, Manager 24 to 30 Years (as on 01-11-2026)
Start Date for Apply Online 27-11-2026
Last Date for Apply Online 11-12-2026
Short Notification Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 Short Notice
Official Website https://www.eximbankindia.in/

Important Dates

  • Short Notification Published Date: 11-11-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 27-11-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 11-12-2026
  • Written Examination Date: December 2026 (Tentative)

Exim Bank Vacancy 2026 - Post Details

India Exim Bank has announced 120 vacancies for Management Trainee and Manager positions. The recruitment includes 90 Management Trainee vacancies and 30 Manager vacancies. The post-wise details are provided below:

Post Name No. of Posts
Management Trainee (MT) 90
Manager 30
Total 120

By category, the 90 Management Trainee posts are UR 40, SC 07, ST 09, OBC (NCL) 25 and EWS 9 (including 03 PwBD). The 30 Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) posts are UR 15, SC 03, ST 02, OBC (NCL) 07 and EWS 03 (including 01 PwBD).

Who Can Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?

Candidates with relevant educational qualifications in management, finance, commerce and other professional disciplines may be eligible for Exim Bank Management Trainee and Manager positions. Final qualification and experience requirements should be checked against the detailed recruitment advertisement.

  • Management Trainee: Candidates with a relevant graduation degree along with MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS qualifications in Finance, International Business or Foreign Trade, or a Chartered Accountancy qualification, may be eligible. Previous MT recruitment rules required specified minimum marks. The exact requirements for this recruitment are yet to be confirmed. The detailed notification says most MT streams need at least 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in a 3-year full-time Graduation and a 2-year full-time Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or CA (ICAI membership mandatory). Streams such as Legal, Cyber Security, Digital Technology, Compliance, HR, Administration, ESG and Corporate Communications have their own qualifications.
  • Manager: Candidates with relevant graduation, postgraduate or professional qualifications and the required post-qualification work experience may be eligible. The detailed advertisement will specify the accepted qualifications and experience. The detailed notification says Manager posts need at least 60% marks in Graduation and a relevant Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) or CA, which varies by stream, plus at least 4 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field.

Note: Candidates should verify the prescribed qualification, minimum marks, experience and other eligibility conditions before submitting an application. Candidates appearing in their final qualifying examinations by May 2027 may also take the written examination. Post-graduation done through online / correspondence / part-time / distance mode is not accepted.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

  • Management Trainee: The previous recruitment eligibility range was 21 to 28 years. The age limit for the 2026 recruitment is subject to confirmation in the detailed notification. The detailed notification confirms it as not below 21 and not above 28 years as on 01 November 2026.
  • Manager: The minimum and maximum age limits will be specified in the detailed notification. The detailed notification sets it at not below 24 and not above 30 years as on 01 November 2026.
  • Age Relaxation: Applicable category-wise relaxation will be governed by the official recruitment rules. The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (NCL). For PwBD it is relaxed by 10 years (General/EWS), 13 years (OBC-NCL) and 15 years (SC/ST), and Ex-servicemen get up to 5 years.

The age calculation cutoff date and applicable relaxations should be verified from the detailed Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 notification.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

  • General / OBC Candidates: Rs. 600/- (Application fee and intimation charges)
  • SC / ST / PwBD / EWS / Female Candidates: Rs. 100/- (Intimation charges only)
  • Payment Mode: As specified in the official application instructions. Payment is online only (Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards / Mobile Wallets) from 27-11-2026 to 11-12-2026.

The category-wise application fee for this recruitment has not been confirmed in the short notice. Candidates should refer to the detailed notification before making any payment. The detailed notification now confirms the fee shown above, and fees once paid are non-refundable.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Salary

  • Management Trainee: Rs. 65,000/- monthly stipend during the one-year training. After training they are absorbed as Deputy Manager (JM-I) in the pay scale Rs. 48480-2000-62480-2340-67160-2680-85920 (CTC about Rs. 25 lakh a year).
  • Manager (MM-II): Rs. 64820-2340-67160-2680-93960 (CTC about Rs. 30 lakh a year).

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process and Exam Pattern

Selection will be through a Written Test and a Personal Interview. The written test is a subjective Professional Knowledge paper of 100 marks lasting 2 hours 30 minutes. Part I is a compulsory question or case study (40 marks) and in Part II candidates attempt any 6 of 8 questions (60 marks), all based on the selected specialization. The final selection is based on 70% weightage for the written test and 30% for the interview. The exam will be held in Chennai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Mumbai and New Delhi, and interviews in Mumbai and / or New Delhi.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026

  • Visit the official India Exim Bank website at https://www.eximbankindia.in/.
  • Open the Careers section on the homepage.
  • Find the recruitment advertisement for Management Trainee and Manager posts.
  • Download and read the detailed notification carefully.
  • Check the required educational qualifications, age limit and experience conditions.
  • Open the official online application link when available (the link will be live from 27 November 2026).
  • Complete the registration process using the required personal and contact details.
  • Fill in the application form with accurate educational, personal and professional information.
  • Upload the required documents, photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as instructed.
  • Pay the application fee, if applicable.
  • Submit the completed application form by 11 December 2026 and save a copy for future reference.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Export-Import Bank of India (EXIM Bank), Mumbai, Maharashtra, has invited applications for 2 posts in 2 roles. The posts include Data Protection Officer (DPO), Deputy Data Protection Officer (Deputy DPO). Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 30 November 2026.

The posts are for Mumbai. Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd. is recruiting 323 Probationary Officers, and only domiciles of the UT of J&K can apply. J&K Bank Probationary Officer Category-wise Vacancy 2026

The notice gives reservation as percentages, not as the number of posts in each category. Reservation follows the Union territory of Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Rules, 2005, as amended from time to time, and S.O. 176 dated March 15, 2024, issued by the Social Welfare Department, Civil Secretariat, J&K.

Category Reservation
Scheduled Castes 8%
Scheduled Tribes – existing list (Bakarwal, Balti, Beda, Bot/Boto, Brokpa/Drokpa/Dard/Shin, Changpa, Garra, Gaddi, Gujjar, Mon, Purigpa, Sippi) 10% (of 20% for Scheduled Tribes)
Scheduled Tribes – added in 2024 (Gadda Brahmin, Koli, Paddari Tribe, Pahari Ethnic Group) 10% (of 20% for Scheduled Tribes)
Other Backward Classes 8%
Residents of areas adjoining Line of Actual Control (ALC)/ International Border (IB) 4%
Residents of Backward Areas 10%
Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs) 10%
Persons with Disabilities 4% (Horizontal Reservation)

Reservation for Persons with Disabilities

Under section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, the 4% reservation is divided as follows:

Disability Reservation
Blindness or low vision 1%
Deaf and Hard of hearing 1%
Locomotor disability including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy 1%
Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness 1%

Multiple disabilities from amongst the above, including deaf-blindness, are also covered. Only persons with benchmark disability (not less than 40% of a specified disability) are eligible for reservation, and they must submit a disability certificate issued by a Competent Authority. PwBD candidates whose certificate shows the condition as "likely to improve" under the temporary disability category are not eligible for reservation; conditions marked "Progressive, non-progressive or not likely to improve" are treated as eligible.

  • A reserved category candidate who figures in the general list on own merit will not be adjusted against a reserved post; the original category stays unchanged.
  • Unfilled EWS vacancies will be filled as per the reservation rules of the UT of J&K.
  • A valid reserved category certificate must be held on the date of online registration.
  • The EWS certificate should be valid for the year 2026-2027.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Post Qualification Required
Probationary Officer Graduate in any discipline from a university recognized by Government of India or any other equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government/UGC, as on the last date of registration.
  • Domicile: only domiciles of the UT of J&K are eligible; selected candidates must submit the domicile certificate issued by the competent authority.
  • The candidate must hold a valid marks sheet/degree certificate showing graduation as on the last date of registration (26 November 2026).
  • The percentage of marks in Graduation, calculated to the nearest two decimals, must be entered while registering online. Where CGPA/OGPA is awarded, it must be converted into percentage, backed by a certificate from the appropriate authority on the University's conversion norms.
  • Percentage is total marks in all subjects of all semesters/years divided by aggregate maximum marks (including honours/optional/additional optional subjects) multiplied by 100. Fractions are ignored: 59.99% is treated as less than 60%.
  • A self-declaration of character and antecedents in a prescribed format is required. Candidature or appointment may be cancelled for material misrepresentation or conviction in a criminal offence involving moral turpitude.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Probationary Officer post.

The age limit is minimum 20 years and maximum 30 years as on 01-01-2026, that is, a candidate must have been born not earlier than 01.01.1996 and not later than 01.01.2006 (both dates inclusive). The maximum age limit applies to General and EWS candidates.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Selection Process 2026

  1. Online Preliminary Examination
  2. Online Mains Examination (Objective & Descriptive)
  3. Interview

Preliminary Examination

Candidates must qualify in each of the three tests by securing cut-off marks decided by IBPS in concurrence with J&K Bank. The minimum aggregate qualifying marks are 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved category candidates, subject to overall merit. Candidates numbering 10 times the vacancies in each category are shortlisted for the Mains.

Mains Examination

Each candidate needs a minimum score in each test and a minimum total score. The minimum aggregate qualifying marks are 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved category, subject to overall merit. Only Mains marks count for shortlisting, and candidates numbering 3 times the vacancies in each category are called for interview. Mains scores are not shared before the interview process is completed.

Interview

The interview carries 100 marks, with minimum qualifying marks of 40% (35% for reserved category). The centre, venue, time and date will be given in the interview call letter, downloaded from https://jkb.bank.in/. The final merit score combines the Mains and the interview in the ratio 80:20, and candidates must qualify in both. Provisional selection is by category-wise merit against the vacancies in each category and will be notified on the Bank's website.

  • The medium of examination is English, and each test is separately timed.
  • The Descriptive Paper may be broadly based on economic and social issues, emerging trends in banking and technology, current events and ethics.
  • Negative marking: one fourth of the marks of a question is deducted for each wrong answer in the objective tests of both the Preliminary and Mains. No penalty for a blank question.
  • Scores from different sessions are normalized using the equi-percentile method, taken up to two decimal points.
  • J&K Bank reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination, which will be intimated through its website.

Examination Centres
