How to Apply Online for J&K Bank Probationary Officer Recruitment 2026

Applications are accepted online only from 07.11.2026 to 26.11.2026; no other mode is accepted. Before starting, keep scanned copies of the photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm, 20kb–50kb, 200 x 230 pixels preferred), signature in black ink (not in capital letters), left thumb impression on white paper, and the hand-written declaration in English, plus an active personal email ID and mobile number.

  1. Go to https://jkb.bank.in/, open the relevant notification under the "Careers" tab and click "APPLY ONLINE".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id; note the Provisional Registration Number and Password sent by Email and SMS.
  3. Validate the details and save with "Save & Next"; the form can be completed in more than one sitting.
  4. Upload the photograph and signature as per specifications, and capture a live photograph by webcam or mobile phone.
  5. Fill the other details of the application form, then preview the whole form.
  6. Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" after checking everything; no change is possible after this.
  7. Click the "Payment" tab, pay the fee online and click "Submit".
  8. Print the e-Receipt and the online Application Form containing fee details.

The hand-written declaration text is: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." A declaration written by anyone else or in another language makes the application invalid. Visually Impaired candidates who cannot write may type it and put their left thumb impression below.

J&K Bank Probationary Officer Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Selected candidates must remain posted within the Zone first allotted for at least 5 years; no transfer outside that Zone is permitted on any ground before then.
  • No change of category is permitted after registration, and requests to be considered under another category will not be entertained.
  • Names of the candidate and father/husband must match the certificates, mark sheets and identity proof.
  • Entry to the Preliminary and Mains needs the call letter and original photo identity proof with a photocopy; Mains candidates must also bring the stamped Preliminary call letter and stamped ID copy.
  • Accepted ID proofs include PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, college/university ID, Aadhaar/E-Aadhaar with photograph or Employee ID; Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted.
  • Bring one additional photograph with the Preliminary call letter; keeping about 8 copies of the uploaded photograph is advised for later stages.
  • Late reporting after the time on the call letter bars entry; biometric data is captured at the Mains, document verification and joining.
  • Original documents (category, domicile, age, qualification) with photocopies are produced at document verification; candidature is cancelled without them at the interview.
  • Scribe users need the Appendix I certificate (uploaded with the application) and Appendix II undertaking; eligible candidates get 20 minutes compensatory time per hour if registered for it while applying.

Its Head Office is at 8-2-680/1&2, Road No.12, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad – 500 034, and the recruitment notice is issued by the bank's Deputy General Manager (HR).

Experience

  • The candidate must have experience of at least 15 years at the senior management level in the Banking sector.

Desirable

  • Knowledge of statutory/regulatory prescriptions law, accountancy, risk management, information technology, etc., is desirable.
  • Candidates with MBA/CFA/ICWA/CA/CS/CAIIB will be given preference.
  • Knowledge of regional language may be considered as an advantage.

Age Limit

The age limit for the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) in DGM Cadre post is not more than 65 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation.

Fit and Proper Criteria

Under the heading "Propriety Criteria & Deed of Covenants", the notice states that candidates may refer to the 'Fit & Proper' criteria of RBI Circular No.RBI/DoS/2026-27/435/DoS.CO.PPG.29/11.01.005/2026-27 dated July 31, 2026 on Appointment of Chief Compliance Officer in Urban Co-operative Banks for further details.

Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

Pay and Terms

  • Remuneration: Commensurate with the Qualification & Experience of the Candidate. The notice does not print a pay scale or amount.

  • Extension: The term may be extended as per extant norms at the discretion of the Management.
  • Cadre: The post is in the DGM Cadre.

How to Apply for AP Mahesh Bank CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER (CCO) IN DGM CADRE

The notice asks for applications by e-mail or by post, on or before 20 November 2026. It gives these steps:

  1. Prepare a Resume with additional information such as Personal Information in the enclosed format (Annexure-1).
  2. Add the propriety criteria and other declaration as per RBI Circular No.RBI/DoS/2026-27/435/DoS.CO.PPG.29/11.01.005/2026-27.

  5. Send it on or before 20.11.2026.

Annexure-1 Application Format

Annexure-1, enclosed with the notice, asks for: full name, father's name, date of birth and age, place of birth, nationality, permanent address, address for communication, telephone numbers, an alternative contact number with the relation of the contact person, e-mail ID, PAN, Aadhar No., and disciplinary proceedings faced, if any, during the entire service. It then asks for educational and professional qualifications beginning with SSC or equivalent (examination passed, board/university, year of passing, subjects), professional qualifications, and awards/achievements/appreciation.

For job experience, the form asks for the total number of years and details in reverse chronological order, starting from the latest: post held, period of service (from and to), name of the bank/company, scale (I/II/III/IV/V/VI), roles of duties, last pay drawn, expected CTC and notice period.

About Indian Bank

Indian Bank describes itself in the notice as a leading Public Sector Bank and a Government of India undertaking, with headquarters in Chennai and a geographical presence all over India and abroad. The posts in this notice are for the bank's Information System Security Department (ISSD), which will use AI/ML capabilities to protect the bank's assets from AI enabled cyber threats.

Vacancy Details

The notice lists 5 vacancies across three posts. The number of vacancies and the number of reserved vacancies are provisional and may vary according to the actual requirement of the Bank.

Post Code Post Name Total
01 Vice President - AI Cybersecurity 1
02 Assistant Vice President - AI Cybersecurity 2

The notice adds that there is no reservation for Ex-servicemen in Officers' Cadre, and that EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives of the Government of India and the outcome of any litigation.

Who Can Apply

The notice invites applications from Indian Citizens. The cut-off date for age, educational qualification, certifications and post-qualification work experience is 01.11.2026.

Educational Qualification (all three posts)

Mandatory: B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (CSE) / Information Technology (IT) / Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) OR M.E. / M. Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (CSE) / Information Technology (IT) / Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE). Qualifications must be from a University / Institution / Board recognised by Govt. of India or approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies. No equivalent educational qualification will be considered for eligibility.

Certification, Experience and Age by Post

Post Age Mandatory Certification Mandatory Experience
Vice President - AI Cybersecurity Min 35 years, Max 48 years CISSP / CISA / CISM Minimum 12 years after graduation in Information Security, of which minimum 5 years in BFSI sector
Assistant Vice President - AI Cybersecurity Min 27 years, Max 40 years CISSP / CISA / CISM Minimum 05 years after graduation in Information Security in BFSI sector
Associate Manager - Senior Officer- AI Cybersecurity Min 25 years, Max 35 years CISSP / CISA / Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) Minimum 03 years after graduation in Information Security in BFSI sector

All stipulated certificates must be valid as on the cut-off date and active on the date of submission of the application and of the interview.

Desirable Certifications and Experience

  • Vice President - AI Cybersecurity: ISACA AAISM (Advanced in AI Security Management) / EC-Council COASP (Certified Offensive AI Security Professional) / GIAC GMLE (Machine Learning Engineer).
  • Assistant Vice President - AI Cybersecurity and Associate Manager - Senior Officer- AI Cybersecurity: ISACA AAISM / EC-Council COASP / GIAC GMLE / CompTIA SecAI+.
  • All three posts (preferable/desirable experience): designing / implementing / tuning / operating AI/ML enabled security monitoring / detection / incident response capabilities.

The maximum age specified applies to General and EWS category candidates. Relaxation in the upper age limit is as follows:

Category Relaxation
Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe 5 Years

Certificates for age relaxation must be submitted at the interview and at any later stage.

  • SC / ST / OBC / PwBD certificates must be issued by the competent authority in the Government of India format; the caste name must match letter by letter with the Central List for the candidate's State/UT.

  • EWS candidates must produce an Income & Asset Certificate based on gross annual income for Financial Year 2025-26 and valid for Financial Year 2026-27, on the date of interview; failing which they will not be considered.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

Pay and Tenure

  • Period of engagement: Fixed Term Employment (FTE) on contractual basis for an initial period of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years, to be renewed yearly or at shorter intervals subject to performance review and the needs and requirements of the Bank.
  • Remuneration and perquisites: negotiable and not a limiting factor for deserving candidate. The notice does not print an amount.
  • Leave: 30 days per calendar year on pro-rata basis; leave balance is not carried forward and leave encashment is not permitted.
  • Termination: three months' notice or three months' fixed component of the compensation in lieu thereof, from either party, at the sole discretion of the Bank.
  • Place of work: Chennai or as decided by the Bank.
  • The engagement is not to be construed as an offer of employment or a regular employment in the Bank, and ends automatically on completion of the contractual period.

Vice President - AI Cybersecurity

  • Lead cybersecurity team that leverages AI/ML capabilities in security operations, incident response, threat detection, threat hunting to protect Bank's assets from AI enabled cyber threats.

Assistant Vice President - AI Cybersecurity

  • Leverage AI/ML capabilities in security operations, incident response, threat detection, threat hunting to protect Bank's assets from AI enabled cyber threats.

Associate Manager - Senior Officer- AI Cybersecurity

  • Leverage AI/ML capabilities in security operations, incident response, threat detection, threat hunting to protect Bank's assets from AI enabled cyber threats.

  1. Fill the application in the prescribed format given as Annexure - A of the notice, pasting a recent passport size colour photograph signed across, and signing at the bottom of all pages (signature in CAPITAL LETTERS is not accepted).
  2. Pay the fee (Rs. 175/- for SC/ST/PwBD; Rs. 1000/- for all other candidates) through Internet Banking / NEFT / RTGS / UPI to Account Name: Indian Bank Recruitment Fee Collection Account, Account Number 7422772966, Indian Bank, Royapettah (Current Account), IFSC IDIB000R021.
  3. Write the Reference number / UTR Number of the payment in the application form.
  4. Enclose self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below.
  5. Put the application in a closed envelope superscribed "Application for the post of AI - Cybersecurity Specialist Officers for Information System Security Department (ISSD) on Contractual Basis - 2026".
  6. Send it to: Chief General Manager (CDO & CLO), Indian Bank, Corporate Office, HRM Department, Recruitment Section, 254-260, Avvai Shanmugam Salai, Royapettah, Chennai, Pin - 600 014, Tamil Nadu, so that it reaches on or before 1 December 2026. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.
  7. Optionally, send an advance signed and scanned copy of the application with supporting documents to [email protected].

A separate application and a separate fee payment are required for each post. Bank transaction charges for the fee are borne by the candidate. The fee is non-refundable.

  • Proof of Date of Birth (the form asks for a copy of the SSC / Birth Certificate).

  • Experience certificate(s) specifying designation / job profile, period of service (with specific dates), emoluments and activity profile of previous and present employers; the certificate must specifically state experience in the related field.

Selection will be by (1) scrutiny of applications by a Screening Committee and (2) interview of shortlisted candidates by a Selection Committee. If the number of applicants is substantially large, a Written Test / Group Discussion / Preliminary interview process or a combination of these may be adopted. Only eligible candidates will be called for interview and intimated by email, and the Bank may send interview call letters to the registered email ID.

  • Original certificates for educational qualifications, certifications, experience, age and category must be produced at the interview; otherwise the candidate will not be allowed for interview.
  • Candidates working in Govt. / quasi-Govt. organisations and public sector banks / undertakings must produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview, and a proper discharge certificate before appointment.
  • Requests to change contact number, address, email ID, interview centre, interview date and time or mode of interview will not be entertained.
  • If a written test is held, scribe and compensatory time rules for persons with benchmark disabilities apply as set out in the notice.

Once the objection window closes, SSC will examine the representations received and finalise the answers in accordance with its rules.

How to Calculate Marks Using SBI Clerk Prelims Answer Key 2026?

If candidates can access their question-wise responses and correct answers, they may estimate their raw scores using the prescribed marking scheme.

Response Type Marks

For example, if a candidate has 72 correct answers and 13 incorrect answers, the estimated raw score would be 68.75 marks.

This calculation is only an estimate. Candidates should rely on the marks displayed by SBI as their official examination score.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

ISS Examination Paper Structure

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.
  • Identify the question number(s) where you believe the answer is incorrect.
  • Prepare a written representation with supporting references from standard textbooks or study material.
  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

This release comes more than two months after SSC declared the Tier 2 final result on 8th April 2026, where 15,118 candidates were provisionally selected for various Group B and Group C posts. What Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section explains what the final answer key actually is and how it differs from the result already announced earlier this year. The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

How to Download SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section walks you through the exact login process to access your final answer key, scorecard, and response sheet from the official SSC portal.

The download process requires your individual login credentials rather than a single public link, since the answer key and scorecard are personalized to each candidate's response sheet. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Look for the notification related to the Tier 2 scorecard and final answer key for CGL 2025-26.
  3. Click on the candidate login link provided in the notification.
  4. Enter your Registration ID and Password to log in.
  5. Your scorecard, final answer key, and response sheet will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and save the PDF files for future reference before the access window closes.

Since this is a login-gated system tied to individual candidate records, there is no generic public download link that works for all candidates; each person must sign in with their own registered credentials.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Paper Correct Answer Wrong Answer
Paper 1 (Sections I, II & Computer Module I) +3 marks -1 mark
Paper 2 (Statistics) +2 marks -0.50 marks

Unattempted questions carry zero marks under both papers, so there is no penalty for skipping a question you were unsure about. Paper 2 was applicable only to candidates who applied for Junior Statistical Officer and Statistical Investigator Grade II posts.

Timeline: From Provisional Key to Final Answer Key

This section traces the complete sequence of events from the Tier 2 exam to the release of the final answer key, helping candidates understand how each stage led to the next.

  • The Tier 2 exam was conducted on 18th and 19th January 2026.
  • The provisional answer key was released on 30th January 2026, with an objection window open until 3rd February 2026 (8:00 PM).
  • SSC reviewed all valid objections submitted against the provisional key.
  • The Tier 2 final result and merit list were declared on 8th April 2026, with 15,118 candidates provisionally selected.
  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

Role Snapshot

Regional Director, Enterprise Sales

This is your moment

Sweden. Norway. Denmark. Finland. Four markets, one region, and a team of elite sellers who are already winning. Abnormal is one of the fastest growing cybersecurity companies in the world, and we are looking for a Regional Director to take the Nordics to its next level.

Every CISO in the region is facing the same problem: attackers are using AI to get past defences built for a different era. Abnormal exists to change that. You will be the leader who gets into the deals, runs to the fire, and builds on a team that is already formidable.

This is not a role for someone who manages a forecast from behind a screen. It is for a leader who would rather be in the room with a CISO than in a meeting about the meeting.

Your mission

Overachieve the Nordics new annual recurring revenue (NARR) quota by winning enterprise accounts (2,000+ mailboxes) from first conversation to signature, and by growing them long after.

Along the way, you will:

  • Take an elite team and make it even better, through coaching, inspiration and an unrelenting standard.
  • Be hands on in the deals that matter, side by side with your Account Executives.
  • Spend your time where the revenue is: with customers, prospects and partners.
  • Build a channel in the region from the ground up, with your own hands.
  • Make the whole region move together, leading marketing, SDR and channel through a matrix model.

How you will lead

Hands on, always. You love getting into the deals with your AEs. You shape the strategy, join the critical calls, open doors at CISO, CIO and CTO level, and help close complex, multi-stakeholder deals from $200K+ through to $1M+.

Inspire the team. You lead with energy and example. You know what great looks like because you have done it, and you make the people around you want to do it too.

Run to the fire. When a deal is wobbling, a customer needs you or a competitor shows up, you are the first one there.

Thrive in velocity. We are low friction on process and high on pace. You enjoy agility, you make decisions quickly, and you are comfortable in a dynamic, Slack-based working culture where the best ideas move at the speed of a message.

Be external first. You will spend more time out in the market than in internal meetings, because that is where the pipeline and the relationships are.

What you will own

  • A programmatic sales playbook. Run a disciplined, repeatable approach to selling, embedded in the 3-Whys and MEDDPICC. Inspect deals with rigour, forecast monthly and quarterly with credibility, and lead Quarterly Business Reviews that drive action.
  • The team. Develop each Account Executive in the areas that matter most to their skills and NARR results. Recruit when the region needs it, and keep a bench of future talent warm so you are never caught short.
  • The matrix. Hold responsibility across channel, marketing and SDR in the region, bringing them together behind one plan to generate pipeline and accelerate new business.
  • The channel. Build strategic relationships with existing channel partners and open up new ones. This is a hands-on builder role, not a hand-off.
  • The customer. Maintain strong relationships with key customers in the region, focused on value realisation, timely renewals, rapid expansion and referrals.
  • The proof. Partner closely with Sales Engineering to deliver outstanding demonstrations and a repeatable proof-of-concept and technology validation programme.
  • The voice of the market. Be the voice of the customer and prospect inside Abnormal, with Sales Engineering, the POV team, Product and Marketing, so the right things get prioritised and more revenue gets closed.

What you bring

You are a proven winner who holds yourself accountable to consistent over-achievement, and who is hungry to build on something already strong.

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota selling security, networking and/or software.
  • 3+ years leading a sales team focused on new business and new logos.
  • A hunter's mentality: you have led teams that create new demand, win new customers and source their own pipeline.
  • A record of closing complex enterprise deals with multiple buying influences, in new or emerging solution categories, including deals of $200K+ and $1M+.
  • Credibility with executives. You build strong relationships with customers and partners at the most senior levels, and translate technical features into business value.
  • Fluency in consultative, value-based methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or Challenger Sale.
  • Experience building or growing a channel, and the instinct to get hands on with partners.
  • Outstanding verbal, written and presentation skills.
  • A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and real enjoyment of a fast-paced, low-process environment.

Why you will love it here

We are building a generational company, and you would be building it with us. Abnormal is one of the fastest growing cybersecurity companies in the world, selling something customers genuinely need in a category that is still being defined. The momentum is real, the product is differentiated and the opportunity ahead is enormous.

Here, builders are not spectators. You will inherit a team of elite sellers and be trusted to make them even better. You will work shoulder to shoulder with Sales Engineering, Product and Marketing, and your voice will shape what we build and how we win. You will have the freedom to move fast, the support to do it well, and a front-row seat to something special.

If you want to lead from the front, build a region and put your name on some of the most important deals in Nordic enterprise security, as part of a company people will talk about for decades, we would love to meet you.

Role Snapshot


About Norm

Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.

Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services.

Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management.

Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.

AI Fluency:
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role

We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead for Norm Compliance, the team that owns Norm's compliance platform for asset managers: the product behind marketing and content review at some of the largest financial institutions in the US. You are an IC-style engineer who can also set an engineering roadmap and lead a team; you will lead up to seven engineers, own every technical decision inside the platform, and ship code yourself at least half of the week.

The platform has been shipping for years. You will ramp with the engineers who know it best, then set its direction.

How You'll Work

The team is fully remote in the US and reports to the General Manager of Norm Compliance. You set the platform's technical direction, from architecture and standards to a roadmap you shape with the product manager and the General Manager. The team owns the platform end to end, including the infrastructure it runs on. Day to day you work with a product manager who owns the backlog and our commitments to clients, and with a client engagement/deployment strategy team that owns the relationships: you decide how the work gets done and how long it takes, they decide what we take on and when, and nothing reaches a client without both. The team runs its own on-call.

You Will

  • Own architecture, technical standards and code review for the platform, and contribute production code every week.

  • Set the engineering roadmap for the platform with the product manager and the General Manager.

  • Hire, onboard and grow a team of Staff and Senior engineers.

  • Run on-call escalation.

  • Answer clients' technical questions, in writing or through meetings, along the client engagement/deployment strategy team.

  • Learn the platform with the engineers who run it today, ship with their review, then own it.

Skills & Experience - Core

  • Bachelor's or Master's in computer science or an equivalent field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 8+ years building production software, including 3+ years leading a team of four to eight engineers while still shipping code

  • Python and TypeScript in production; Postgres or similar; AWS

  • Experience taking over a large codebase built by others and running it

  • Experience setting and delivering a technical roadmap for a product with enterprise clients

  • Experience on client calls, answering hard technical questions without over-promising

  • Clear, brief writing

Skills & Experience - Pluses

  • Clients in financial services or another regulated industry

  • Experience with LLM-backed products, Terraform, or a workflow engine such as Temporal

  • Experience splitting a release pipeline or a shared repository, or hiring a team from zero

What Success Looks Like - 90 Days

  • You know the platform's architecture and its largest clients, and have shipped with code review from the team

  • You own the platform's technical decisions and run on-call escalation

  • The team has run an incident end to end, and you, the team and the product manager have a written way of working

Comp and Benefits

$220,000 - $290,000 a year plus equity.

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills (as uncovered during the interview process), experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed here reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity or benefits. We offer a competitive salary along with equity compensation. Our comprehensive benefits package includes a 401(k) plan with an employer match. Employees enjoy top-tier insurance coverage, encompassing health, dental, hospital, accident, and vision plans. You'll thrive in our fast-paced learning environment where professional growth is constant.

This role is fully remote within the United States, with core hours on US Eastern time. You will start in our New York office at One World Trade Center. Norm employment, US residency and work performed from the US are conditions of the role; because our clients are financial institutions, offers are conditional on a background check, including E-Verify. Visa sponsorship or transfer is not available for this position.

If you're interested in the role but aren't sure whether you're a good fit, we'd still like to hear from you.

To learn more about Norm, visit our website.

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

Weâre building the industryâs first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Own the partner channel that sources a meaningful share of Salesloftâs new closed-won revenue.

The primary measure is closed-won revenue sourced through partners, supported by partner-influenced revenue and the retention and expansion of partner-sourced customers. Private Equity Partnerships

Cloud Marketplace and Strategic Platform Alliances

  • Own Salesloft's go-to-market with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including marketplace listings, private offers, and co-sell programs that let customers buy against their existing cloud commitments.
  • Build strategic alliances with the CRM and productivity platforms our customers run on, such as Salesforce, Microsoft, and HubSpot, including their app and agent marketplaces.

ISV and MCP Partnerships

  • Work with Product and Engineering to shape the partner integration roadmap and make sure partners can build, launch, and sell with confidence.
  • Design partner economics for AI and agent partners, including revenue share on usage- and consumption-based pricing alongside seat-based models.

VAR, BPO, and Services Partnerships

  • Recruit and onboard value-added resellers and business process outsourcing providers that resell, bundle, or deliver Salesloft as part of their sales services.
  • Recruit systems integrators and RevOps consultancies that influence enterprise buying decisions and deliver implementations, and build a services partner motion that speeds time to value and improves retention.

  • Equip partner sellers with value-selling playbooks, competitive positioning, and qualification criteria so deals are sourced and closed consistently.

  • Lead from the Front: Youâll be the executive face of Salesloft to strategic partners and set the quotas, coverage models, and standards your team is held to.
  • Make Your Mark: Youâll shape how Salesloft shows up in private equity, cloud marketplaces, ISV and MCP ecosystems, and services channels, not just run the playbook.

WHAT WEâRE LOOKING FOR
Youâre a senior partner and alliances leader who has sourced and closed partner-driven revenue in B2B SaaS and led teams to quota. You build the relationships and programs that turn into signed deals, and you are credible with C-level partners and technical teams alike. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOUâLL BRING

  • 12+ years of experience in partner sales, channel sales, alliances, or business development in B2B SaaS, with senior leadership experience managing teams
  • A track record of sourcing and closing partner-driven revenue and meeting or exceeding quota, with results you can describe in terms of closed-won revenue
  • Experience building or working with private equity relationships, ISV or technology integration partnerships, cloud marketplace and co-sell programs with AWS, Microsoft, or Google Cloud, or VAR, BPO, and services channel programs. Experience in more than one of these is strongly preferred
  • Experience building a partner program from the ground up, or rebuilding one after a merger or acquisition
  • An established network of private equity operating partners and portfolio company leaders
  • Familiarity with AI, API, and MCP-based integration ecosystems, and the ability to talk credibly with technical partners about how Salesloft fits
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex partner, reseller, and revenue-sharing agreements
  • Ability to coach and lead a team, including setting quotas and holding people accountable to them
  • Strong sales acumen and fluency with CRM and partner tools such as Salesforce, partner relationship management platforms, and account-mapping tools, including building partner attribution models. SaaS experience is required
  • Executive presence, including comfort presenting at conferences, events, and webinars and influencing C-suite stakeholders
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Product, Marketing, and Revenue teams

THE TEAM
Youâll lead the Channel Sales & Alliances team of partner sales and alliance professionals and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Legal, and RevOps. Itâs a place to grow as the executive owner of a channel plan, a team, and the results.

  • Â Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team.

Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over.

  • Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems.

  • Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision.
  • Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills.

Role Snapshot

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.


Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering

  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

  • Regular use of an AI coding tool

  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now

  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)


Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments


Terms

  • Between US$400 - US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork


Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

About Supabase

About the Role

Weâre looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

About Us

We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health.

Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today.

By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth.

We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company.

Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B.

We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where".

Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare.

Role overview

Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution.

What Youâll Do

  • Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows.

  • Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas.

  • Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas.

  • Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs.

  • Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance.

  • Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions.

Accounts receivable and collections

  • Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines.

  • Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements.

  • Review and respond to escalations when a specialist cannot determine the next action; surface recurring payer, workflow, or system issues to leadership and coordinate their resolution.

  • Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB.

  • Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution.

  • Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process.

Quality and team development

  • Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance.

  • Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues.

  • Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations.

  • Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB).

  • Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs.

  • Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets.

  • Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve.

  • Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements.

  • Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams.

  • Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities.

  • Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams.

  • Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows.

  • Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity.

  • Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive health insurance, dental, and commuter benefits

  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer contribution

  • Opportunity for growth in a fast-growing company

  • Collaborative team valuing innovation and problem-solving

Role Snapshot

About us

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role

Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

  • Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

  • Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

  • Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

  • Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

  • Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

  • Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

  • Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

  • Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

  • Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

  • Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

  • Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

Your background

You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

  • A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

  • Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

  • Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

  • A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

  • A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

  • Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦

  • Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;

  • Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;

  • Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.

  • Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.

  • Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

KPIs & Success Measures

We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output:

  • Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%.

  • First workflow conversion: percentage of new users who complete a successful run within their first [TBD] days.

  • Share of generations through workflows: percentage of all generations produced by workflow runs.

  • Agent and human collaboration: percentage of workflow runs built or started by Scribble.

  • Connector adoption: percentage of active workspaces that use at least one third-party connection in a workflow each month. Target [TBD]%.

  • Integration usage: percentage of workflow runs that start from, or deliver to, a third-party connection. Target [TBD]%.

  • Reliability (hygiene bar): percentage of runs that complete without manual intervention, held at or above [TBD]%.

  • Learning velocity (supporting): percentage of launches reviewed after release against their stated hypothesis. Target 100%.

Benefits

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for our UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We're called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group's mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco ItaÃº, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of PokÃ©mon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns.

https://www.thebrandtechgroup.com

Role Snapshot


ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply


Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

Applications close on Monday 16 November 2026, 23:59 CET.

We read every application after the deadline and reply to everyone.

Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.

We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

Signing a capture partner is the start of the work. Getting that partner to steady, high-quality output takes onboarding, training, hardware, support, and reporting, and every step has to run on time.

As Partnership Operations Manager, you will own that path for our regional partnership leads so they can focus on finding and signing partners. This is a new function, so you will set the standards and tooling yourself and make them repeatable across regions.

What You Will Do

  • Deal support: Prepare proposals and agreements from approved templates and keep a clean record of every partnerâs rates, volumes, and term dates.

Act when numbers slip, and raise anything commercial with the partnerâs regional lead. Keep scorecards, business reviews, and the data behind them current.

  • Execution: A record of running many partner launches at once across time zones, with clear process and tight follow-up.

  • Organization: Highly organized and detail-focused, able to manage many partners and tasks at once without letting things slip.
